newsitem.title: UK: GKN up after news of bid for Sinter Metals.
newsitem.headline: GKN up after news of bid for Sinter Metals.

text.p: Shares in British engineering and automotive group GKN Plc added to early gains after news it was bidding for U.S. Sinter Metals, dealers said.
GKN shares were up 28 pence, or 3.07 percent, to 939p by 1150 GMT in volume of 705,000.
GKN said it planned to buy Sinter Metals for $570 million in cash and already had 43 percent acceptances.
GKN said its bid would offer Sinter shareholders $37 per share, compared to Tuesday's closing price of $27.
GKN has long been the subject of speculation it might bid for British engineering firm Vickers Group Plc. The story resurfaced in last weekend's newspapers.
Vickers shares were 2.5p lower at 212.5p in turnover of 220,000. The FTSE-100 index was up 0.4 point (0.01 percent) at 4433.6.
